themes.name: Grid build-out for AI power demand
themes.thesis: Utilities are winning large transmission awards (Ameren's $1.23B MISO project) while AI data-centre load outruns the grid. Spending flows to the contractors those utilities name as suppliers.
evidence: Ameren Consortium Selected by MISO for $1.23 Billion Iowa Transmission Project
Bloom Energy CEO Says America's Power Grid Can't Keep up With AI Boom
PWR 10-K names AEE, AEP, PCG as customers

calls.mechanism: supplier link: names AEE/AEP/PCG as customers; transmission capex awards flow to the contractor
event: $1.23B transmission award grows the regulated rate base
sector: electrical equipment demand from grid and data-centre build-out

themes.name: Satellite-to-cell deal re-rates tower sites

AT&T Stock Tumbles as SpaceX Eyes 80,000 Cell Sites
